pkgmetadata.longdescription: Builds and installs the five Experimental Prismdrake PD2 executables: prismdrake-session, prismdrake-settingsd, prismdrake-notifyd, prismdrake-shell, and prismdrake-shellctl. The package also installs the packaged defaults, themes, schemas, X session entry, and the Experimental Settings1, NotificationCenter1, Shell1, and Session1 D-Bus interface contracts. It remains a bounded development prototype and not a production desktop release.
